description: `<script setup lang="ts" generic="T">` declares type parameters for a component, inferred from its props at usage.
`T extends { id: number }` restricts what consumers can pass and tells the component what it can rely on.
Macro that types slot names and slot props, e.g. `default(props: { item: T }): any`.
Generic types disappear at runtime; props typed as `T` are not validated in the browser.
